property_summary: For any admissible parameters, calling initialize(_baseToken,...) must set the pool's baseToken to exactly _baseToken; the mutant skips that assignment so baseToken stays address(0), violating the rule for any nonzero _baseToken.
After any successful initialize, c.baseToken() must equal the _baseToken argument passed in; the mutant stores _nft instead, so it differs whenever _baseToken != _nft.

For any admissible base token address, after initialize(baseToken, ...) the pool's public baseToken getter must equal the address passed in; the mutant always stores address(0), breaking this for any nonzero base token.
